On 28 February 2019, the U.S. draft S/2019/186 failed 9–3–3 due to permanent-member vetoes by China and Russia [US-VOTE]. The Russian draft S/2019/190 failed 4–7–4 for lack of affirmative votes [RU-VOTE]. The U.S. draft proposed a peaceful electoral process with international observation. The Russian draft supported inclusive dialogue, including the Montevideo Mechanism [US-TEXT, RU-TEXT]. Both addressed humanitarian assistance. The U.S. text proposed unhindered access. The Russian text called for government leadership and consent [US-TEXT, RU-TEXT]. Ndong Mba announced both votes as Council President. Equatorial Guinea abstained on the U.S. text and backed the Russian text [CHAIR]. Neither draft created Council authority. Analytical suggestion: compare the proposals for areas that could be discussed separately.
